args.summary:
Model completed successfully for the 8×30 m precast prestressed T-girder bridge (made continuous).

STRUCTURE: 2D spine-beam idealization (MR-01), continuous system (MR-05; support lines named "Pier" have no column data, so bearings sit on rigid supports). Span 30 m ×8, deck 12.5 m.

SECTION/MATERIAL: 5 precast T-girders per span, section integrated from geometry (h=2.0 m) → single A=0.862 m², I=0.4450 m⁴; combined A=4.31 m², I=2.225 m⁴. C50 concrete: Ec=34500 MPa (JTG3362-3.1.5), γ=26 kN/m³ (JTGD60-4.2.1), w=112.06 kN/m, m=11.423 t/m (MR-07, girder self-weight only).

BEARINGS: 9 support lines, 5 bearings each (per girder end × 5 girders, MR-04). All are laminated elastomeric 300×400 mm, 5×8 mm layers (te=0.04 m, S=10.714). Sliders (Abutment 0, Piers 1-3, 6-7, Abutment 8) are PTFE sliding → longitudinal free, Kh=0. Piers 4-5 are plain (fixed) → longitudinal spring, Kh=15000 kN/m. Kv=7.098×10⁶ kN/m for all.

LIVE LOAD: Highway Class I (JTG D60-2015), one-way, 3 lanes (n_lanes=3, xi=0.78), qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320 kN per 30 m span, μ=0.251 from f1.

RESULTS: First vertical frequency f1=4.520 Hz. Self-weight reaction at abutments ≈1328 kN, at interior piers up to 3807 kN. Peak lane-load positive moment 8355.8 kN·m (end spans), max negative moment −6145.4 kN·m. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
